sections.title: Compare a solo consultation with a shared appointment
sections.html:
For colour analysis in Halifax, a shared appointment offers a modest per-person saving but requires a longer shared block of time. Compare the actual format with your schedule and how comfortable you feel asking questions in front of someone else. The cheapest total is not necessarily the most convenient choice.

High Chroma

The Halifax service menu lists a solo consultation at C$325 plus tax for 1.5–2 hours and a two-person session at C$600 plus tax for 3.5–4 hours. The latter is C$300 per person before tax. It describes a 36-colour wallet, digital palette and hair, makeup and metal guidance.

View the provider’s service information ↗

sections.title: Agree on privacy before choosing a partner
sections.html:
Confirm whether both people receive the same palette materials and individual draping time. Ask about tax, deposits and what happens if one guest cancels. If you are comparing a mini event with a full session, list the differences in the take-home result. A social group experience should not be assumed to include every part of the longer private consultation.

  • Is the quoted two-person price a total, and is tax additional?
  • Does each guest receive the same wallet and digital materials?

sections.title: Learn to use the 36-colour reference
sections.html: After the visit, use the physical and digital references for different tasks: hold the wallet beside clothes and use the phone reference for planning. Stylist AI offers its own palette exploration and color tools, which you can consider before committing to a longer appointment. Start with three outfits from your current wardrobe so the advice becomes practical before you spend on new items.

sections.title: Choose shared explanation or private experimentation
sections.html:
Some people learn well by hearing a friend’s comparisons explained beside their own; others want to discuss makeup or wardrobe concerns privately. Ask how the duo handles those moments. The menu describes a 36-colour wallet, a digital palette and hair, makeup and metal guidance—confirm that each guest receives the stated materials.

Stylist AI offers an independent way to begin: follow the photo introduction, explore seasonal colours and outfit pairings, then try makeup or hair previews. Its camera comparison keeps the palette relevant while considering clothes later. You can compare ideas with a friend without purchasing a shared appointment. Choose High Chroma’s consultation for physical draping and personal explanation; choose the app for self-directed colour trials.
